title: How to Disable "Activate Windows" Notification on Your PC or Laptop? - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Does Activate Windows Notification trouble you? If you are looking for remediation to get rid of "Your Windows license will expire soon" Activate the Windows popup or notification. You are on the right page. Here in this article, we will show you how to get rid of Activate Windows popup notification on your PC or Laptop?" in 5 simple steps. Let's get started.

Steps to Disable Windows Notification on Your PC or Laptop:

Follow the below steps on Windows to disable activate the Windows popup notification.

Step 1: From your Windows Desktop, press Win + R >> now in the Run dialog box type in regedit >> Click on OK

Step 2: Navigate the following location path "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsNT\CurrentVersion\SoftwareProtectionPlatform\Activation". Refer to Image.

Step 3: Now in the right pane of the registry editor >> hover to ‘Manual’ >> Double click on it and select the Base Hexadecimal and modify the value data as 0. Refer to the below image.

Step 4: Now do the same for NotificationDisabled. Hover to ‘NotificationDisabled’ >> Double click on it and select the Base Hexadecimal and modify the value data as 0. Refer to the below image.

Step 5: Close the Registry Editor and restart your Windows PC or laptop to get rid of the activate Windows popup.
